truth_claims.note: conf=0.9; Short story set in the Alexis Carew universe, following Jon Bartlett, set ~30 years before Into the Dark and intended to be read after The Little Ships (#3). Goodreads catalogues it as Alexis Carew #3.5; the EPUB's "#301" is the publisher's Kindle side-story numbering (compare Planetfall listed as "Alexis Carew Book 101"). A portion of it was later expanded into the novel Spacer (Spacer, Smuggler, Pirate, Spy #1, 2018).

truth_claims.note: conf=0.9; The EPUB metadata's "#301" is a bogus/internal sort number, not a real series position. Verified: this is a short story (2015) in J.A. Sutherland's Alexis Carew space-opera series, listed on Goodreads as Alexis Carew #3.5 — it is set ~30 years before Into the Dark (#1) and is best read after The Little Ships (#3). Protagonist is Jon Bartlett, whose story was later expanded in the related "Spacer, Smuggler, Pirate, Spy" sub-series; the tight placement for this exact title remains Alexis Carew 3.5. (LibraryThing loosely lists it as "Book 7" by publication order, which is not the canonical position.)
